## QA Run 16 — API sweep complete

**Results: 257 endpoint hits across all 36 route files. 0 5xx errors. 0 crashes. 0 API bugs.**

This is the **second consecutive fully-clean API sweep** (Run 15 was the first).

### Commits this run
| Commit | Subject |
|---|---|
| `4719928` | test(qa): fix harness expectations for 3 false-positive 400s |

The only commit was a test-harness fix — the API code was untouched because nothing was broken. Three test calls were sending invalid params (`outcome:'callback'` on canvass-pin, missing `start/end` on calendar, missing `state/county` on disaster-declarations) and the harness flagged the API's correct 400 responses as "issues." Fixed by sending valid params and adding negative cases for the 400 paths.

### Deliverables
- `/tmp/api-test-results.txt` — 178-row main harness pipe-table
- `/tmp/api-test-results-extended.txt` — 79-row extended write-flow table
- `memory/overnight_resume.md` updated for Run 17

### Notable observations
- Empty-body 200s on 17 write endpoints re-confirmed as intentional (PATCH no-ops, idempotent status flips, batch jobs). Spot-checked `POST /properties/geocode` (correctly 400s on `{}`) and `POST /invoices/:id/send` (no body needed, status flip only).
- The API surface is stable. Worth pivoting next API-sweep slot to browser-interactive write flows (last exercised Run 6) rather than re-scanning the same surface.
